name: GA4 Analytics
description: Read-only, privacy-respecting access to Google Analytics 4: reports, comparisons, realtime, and field discovery.

credentials.label: Service account key file
credentials.help: Path to a Google service-account JSON key. Falls back to GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS, then to gcloud application-default credentials.

propertyId.label: Default GA4 property id
propertyId.help: The numeric id, for example 123456789. Not the G-XXXXXXX measurement id.

privacy.redact.label: Redact personal data in report values
privacy.redact.help: Masks emails, tokens, ids and unsafe query-string values before the model sees them. Leave this on.

privacy.allowUserIdentifyingDimensions.label: Allow person-identifying dimensions
privacy.allowUserIdentifyingDimensions.help: Permits userId and user-scoped custom dimensions. Off by default.

privacy.propertyAllowlist.label: Property allowlist
privacy.propertyAllowlist.help: When set, only these property ids may be queried.

privacy.auditLogPath.label: Audit log path
privacy.auditLogPath.help: Append one line per API call (time, property, tool, fields). Never records response data.
